entries.reason: Armor of the SH-51 backpack body (published Main Armor Heavy). The body has no populated damage zone, so every hit on the body resolves to this default zone. It is not the barrier's armor: the barrier is a separate entity. Not yet shown in game.

Health of the SH-51 backpack body (the emitter on the back, published Main Health 400). The energy barrier is a separate entity with its own shield and health: author it through hd2.backpack('SH-51 Directional Shield'):energy_shield(). Not yet shown in game.
